technicalVerdict.interpretation: Workflow success is not strategy success. Full-period 2025-2026 runs were killed before metrics were produced, so V3 cannot pass a statistical gate.

strategyRiskContractObserved.meaning: The raw strategy can repeatedly adjust/add to positions and carries a -99% strategy stoploss. This is incompatible with the user's no-martingale/no-DCA requirement without a separate guardrailed variant.

2025: One force_exit loss was about -9.82% after 1d 05:45.
One exit_bad_trade_abandon_23d loss was -10.87% after 23d 06:20 and lost about 6.351 USDT on the 50 USDT account simulation.

reasons: V3 full-period and stress runs did not complete.
2025 worst day exceeded the 2 USDT daily loss cap.
Raw X8 enables unlimited position adjustments/rebuys, conflicting with no martingale/DCA.
Trade frequency was only 0.53/day in 2025 and 0.30/day in 2026, below the user's desired active cadence.
Historical 2025-2026 performance is not true author-unseen OOS because the strategy was developed during this era.

next: V4: memory-safe annual stress 0.80%/1.00%, five chronological frozen windows, deterministic symbol holdout, lookahead analysis.
